Type: four-shelf wood bookcase
Use: storing books, displaying decor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: reclaimed pine, painted white frame, natural wood shelves and top
Colors: white, warm honey pine
Shape: tall open frame, chunky square posts, thick overhanging wood top, three wooden shelves, white base shelf, block feet, sturdy medium weight
Feel: cozy, homey, bright, sturdy
Goes with: white or sage walls, linen, woven baskets, warm wood; farmhouse, cottage or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Barrett Reclaimed Wood 4-Shelf Bookcase, 40"W, White and Sandstone Pine
product.description: 40"W x 15"D x 74”H Solid, recycled pine wood with natural imperfections for rustic touch Five wide shelves provide generous display and storage space. Display your prized family photos or works by your favorite authors on this rustic bookshelf. Influenced by early Americana style, it's made of recycled and reclaimed wood in a white and weathered sandstone finish that adds old world charm. No assembly required. Dust with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
